paragraphs.text: Pause model activity host-wide or per session in DeepSeek Harness, including subagents and goals
# dsh-session-pause
English | 简体中文
A DeepSeek Harness bundle that pauses model activity with one click or command — of every Session on
the host, or of one Session and the subagents it starts — including goal rounds and turns woken by
schedules or job notices, and resumes each one where it stopped. Nothing is cancelled: held Agents c
ontinue their turns after resume without a "continue" message. Design and rationale: docs/design.md.
## Install
Install a release from GitHub:

Version 0.4.0 requires DeepSeek Harness 0.2.2-alpha.2 or a later 0.2 release. For DeepSeek Harness 0
.2.1 releases, install `#v0.3.0`.
pnpm builds the plugin through its `prepare` script during installation, and blocks that script unti
l it is allowed. On the first attempt, add the key pnpm prints under `allowBuilds` in the profile's
`pnpm-workspace.yaml` and run the command again; the Web **Plugins** page offers **Allow these scrip
ts and retry** instead.
The `main` branch requires DeepSeek Harness 0.2.2-rc.1 or a later 0.2 release. To develop from a loc
ranch requires DeepSeek Harness 0.2.2-rc.1 or a later 0.2 release. To develop from a local checkout:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`dsh plugin add` links the checkout and appends the bundle to the profile. After code changes, rebui
ld and restart the profile.
Either way, the bundle's patch `cordis.patch.yml` mounts the plugin with its state file at `$DSH_HOM
E/session-pause.json`.
## Web client
- **Pause all** sits in the sidebar foot above Settings (icon only in the collapsed rail). It pauses

the whole host; while paused it reads **Resume all** and ends the host-wide pause.
- A status pill
appears below the Session header while the host is paused: since when, how many operations wait, the
pause reason, and a **Resume** action. It also reports a failed host-wide pause or resume request.
- A pause icon in the composer toolbar, before the model selector, pauses the Session in view; while

that Session is paused it turns into a play icon that resumes it.
- A **This session is paused** st
rip above the composer shows while the Session in view is paused: since when, how many of its own op
erations wait, the reason, and a **Resume** action. It also reports a failed request for this Sessio
ations wait, the reason, and a **Resume** action. It also reports a failed request for this Session.
All surfaces follow the host through the `sessionPause/follow` Remote stream, so a pause started fro
m a command, another browser tab, or before a page reload shows up at once. Copy is localized for `z
another browser tab, or before a page reload shows up at once. Copy is localized for `zh` and `en`.
## Commands
| Command | Effect |
| `/pause-all [reason]` | Pause the whole host; pausing again keeps the original start time and reas

on |
| `/resume-all` | Resume every held operation |
| `/pause-session [reason]` | Pause the Session

that receives the command and the subagents it starts |
| `/resume-session` | Resume the Session th

at receives the command |
| `/pause-status` | Show the host-wide pause, each Session pause, and each

ommand |
| `/pause-status` | Show the host-wide pause, each Session pause, and each held operation |
`/pause-all`, `/resume-all`, and `/pause-status` act on the whole host regardless of the Session tha
t receives them; command output is English. Other plugins use the `ctx.sessionPause` service: `pause
({ source, reason? })`, `resume()`, `pauseSession(sessionId, { source, reason? })`, `resumeSession(s
essionId)`, `status()`, `follow(signal)`, `waitForResume(signal, operation)`, and the `session-pause
/changed` event. All but `waitForResume` are also Remote methods of the `sessionPause` namespace, wh
ose descriptors live in `src/host/remote.ts` and must change together with the service methods.
## Configuration
| Field | Meaning |
| `stateFile` | JSON file holding the pause across host restarts; omission keeps the pause in this p
| JSON file holding the pause across host restarts; omission keeps the pause in this process only |
The plugin writes version 2 of the state file and still reads version 1, which held only the host-wi
de pause. A state file that is not JSON or holds another version fails the plugin load with its path
e pause. A state file that is not JSON or holds another version fails the plugin load with its path.
## Behavior
The host-wide pause covers every Agent. A Session pause covers that Session and every Session it sta
rted as a subagent, as far as their Agents are live. The two kinds begin and end independently: **Re
sume all** leaves individually paused Sessions paused, and resuming a Session does not lift the host
eaves individually paused Sessions paused, and resuming a Session does not lift the host-wide pause.
While a pause covers an operation, three extension points wait for resume, and each wait ends at onc
e when its operation is cancelled, so the stop button keeps working:

- `agent/pre-step`: an Agent waits before its next step; its status stays `running`.
- `llm/stream`:
a model call waits before reaching its provider, including calls made outside an Agent step such as

compaction and Session titles. A call that names no Session waits only for the host-wide pause.
- `
agent/request-error`: a model request that fails during the pause, such as a stream cut by lost conn
ectivity, waits and is retried at resume without backoff and without counting against `dsh-llm-retry
tivity, waits and is retried at resume without backoff and without counting against `dsh-llm-retry`.
[该节后续省略]
## Known limitations
- If the host exits while an Agent waits before a step, the messages claimed for that step are lost;

the loop repairs the open turn as `interrupted` on restart, and goals need `/goal resume`.
- Held A
gents still show as running in the conversation and the Session list; the status pill and the dock s

trip report what is held.
- A Session pause stays in the state file until it is resumed, even after

the Session is deleted; `/pause-status` lists it.
- A slash command typed before a new Session's fir
st message has been created is queued as an ordinary message instead of running; use the sidebar but

ton there.
- External subagent providers (ACP, Codex, Claude Code) run in other products and are not

ere.
- External subagent providers (ACP, Codex, Claude Code) run in other products and are not held.
